headline: 100% duty-free export, major India-New Zealand agreement; creates ₹35,000 crore trade target
summary: The India-New Zealand free trade agreement will come into force on 20 October 2026, with Indian exports made 100% duty-free from the first day. Reports say it could draw on 20 billion dollars of investment.
why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and can expand market access and investment flows between the two economies.
